pagetitle: "CONSORT-Surrogate checklist"
page-layout: full
toc: false
resources:

  - /assets/logos/equator_logo.png
  - docx.min.js
---

```{=html}
<style>
  #tp-wrap { --accent:#3a3f9e; --head:#3a3f9e; --sect:#dde1f5; --sub:#eef0fa; --box:#eef0ff; --boxline:#9aa3e0; --line:#222;
    font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; color:#111; max-width:1000px; margin:0 auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-top { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; margin-bottom:.6rem; }
  #tp-wrap #tp-logo { width:min(300px,55%); height:auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-right { text-align:right; }
  /* EQUATOR logo: hidden on screen, shown only in the saved PDF (print) and Word file */
  #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:none; width:150px; height:auto; margin:0 0 .4rem auto; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:20px; font-weight:bold; margin:.2rem 0 .4rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; margin:.4rem 0 .8rem; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; width:100%; font-weight:bold; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { flex:0 1 50%; min-width:0; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:normal; padding:.35rem .5rem;
    border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); background:var(--box); border-radius:3px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-meta input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap table { border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; font-size:13px; line-height:1.35; }
  #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap td { border:1.5px solid var(--line); padding:3px 6px; vertical-align:middle; }
  #tp-wrap td.txt { border-top:1px dotted #444; border-bottom:1px dotted #444; }
  #tp-wrap thead th { background:var(--head); color:#fff; font-weight:bold; text-align:left; }
  #tp-wrap th.c, #tp-wrap td.c { text-align:center; }
  #tp-wrap tr.sec td { background:var(--sect); font-weight:bold; padding:2px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap tr.sub td { background:var(--sub); font-weight:bold; font-style:italic; padding:2px 6px; }
  #tp-wrap td.topic { width:17%; vertical-align:top; }
  #tp-wrap td.item { width:6%; text-align:center; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg { width:11%; padding:3px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border:1.5px solid var(--boxline); border-radius:3px; background:var(--box);
    text-align:center; font:14px Arial,sans-serif; padding:6px 2px; }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:hover { border-color:var(--accent); }
  #tp-wrap td.pg input:focus { outline:2px solid var(--accent); background:#fff; }
  #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:#7f86b8; font-size:12px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:block; font-weight:normal; font-size:11px; }
  #tp-wrap .tp-cite { margin-top:1rem; font-size:13px; }
  .tp-actions { display:flex; gap:.6rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:1rem 0 1.4rem; }
  .tp-actions button { font:600 15px Arial,sans-serif; padding:.55rem 1.1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;
    border:2px solid #3a3f9e; background:#3a3f9e; color:#fff; }
  .tp-actions button.alt { background:#fff; color:#3a3f9e; }
  .tp-actions button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f3b800; outline-offset:2px; }
  .tp-note { font:14px Arial,sans-serif; color:#444; margin:0; flex-basis:100%; }

  @media print {
    @page { size:A4 portrait; margin:12mm; }
    body * { visibility:hidden; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap * { visibility:visible; }
    #tp-wrap { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; max-width:none; }
    .tp-actions { display:none !important; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-eq { display:block; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-title { font-size:15px; }
    #tp-wrap table { font-size:10px; }
    #tp-wrap tr { break-inside:avoid; }
    #tp-wrap thead { display:table-header-group; }
    #tp-wrap td.pg input { background:none; border:0; }
    #tp-wrap input::placeholder { color:transparent; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-hint { display:none; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-cite { font-size:9.5px; }
    #tp-wrap, #tp-wrap th, #tp-wrap tr.sec td, #tp-wrap tr.sub td { -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact; }
    #tp-wrap .tp-meta input { border:0; padding:0; background:none; flex:1 1 auto; }
  }
</style>

<div id="tp-wrap">
  <div class="tp-top">
    <img src="/assets/logos/consort-surrogate-logo.png" alt="SPIRIT-CONSORT Surrogate: Reporting Guidelines for Surrogate Endpoints" id="tp-logo">
    <div class="tp-right">
      <img src="/assets/logos/equator_logo.png" alt="EQUATOR Network" class="tp-eq">
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-title">The combined CONSORT-Surrogate extension checklist</div>
  <div class="tp-actions">
    <button type="button" id="tp-pdf">Save as PDF</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-doc" class="alt">Save as Word</button>
    <button type="button" id="tp-reset" class="alt">Clear all</button>
    <p class="tp-note">Type the page number(s) where each item is reported in the boxes in the right-hand column, then save your copy as a PDF or Word (.docx) file. “Save as PDF” opens your browser’s print dialog: choose <em>Save as PDF</em> as the destination.
    Your entries stay in this browser until you clear them.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="tp-meta"><label>Manuscript title: <input type="text" id="tp-title" data-key="title" placeholder="Type your manuscript title here"></label></div>
  <table id="tp-table">
    <thead><tr>
      <th>Section/Topic</th><th class="c">Item No</th><th>CONSORT-Surrogate items</th>
      <th class="c">Reported on page No<span class="tp-hint">type page no. in the boxes below</span></th>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  </table>
  <p class="tp-cite">Please cite as: Manyara AM, Davies P, Stewart D, et al. Reporting of surrogate endpoints in randomised controlled trial reports (CONSORT-Surrogate): extension checklist with explanation and elaboration. <em>BMJ</em> 2024;386:e078524. <a href="https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2023-078524" target="_blank" rel="noopener">doi:10.1136/bmj-2023-078524</a></p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // ["Topic", "item", "text"]; topic "" = continuation row.
  // Plain strings = section bars; ["#", "label"] = sub-section bar.
  const ROWS = [
    "Title and abstract",
    ["","1a","Identification as a randomised trial in the title"],
    ["","1b","Structured summary of trial design, methods, results, and conclusions (for specific guidance, see CONSORT for abstracts)"],
    ["","1b.1","State a) that the primary outcome is a surrogate endpoint, and b) the target outcome(s) whose intervention effect is being substituted for."],
    "Introduction",
    ["Background and objectives","2a","Scientific background and explanation of the rationale"],
    ["","2b","Specific objectives or hypotheses"],
    ["","2.1","State a) that the primary outcome is a surrogate endpoint, and b) the target outcome(s) whose intervention effect is being substituted for (when reporting 2a or 2b)"],
    "Methods",
    ["Trial design","3a","Description of trial design (such as parallel, factorial), including allocation ratio"],
    ["","3b","Important changes to methods after trial commencement (such as eligibility criteria), with reasons"],
    ["Participants","4a","Eligibility criteria for participants"],
    ["","4b","Settings and locations where the data were collected"],
    ["Interventions","5","The interventions for each group with sufficient details to allow replication, including how and when they were actually administered"],
    ["Outcomes","6a","Completely defined pre-specified primary and secondary outcome measures, including how and when they were assessed"],
    ["","6a.1","State the practical or scientific reason(s) for using a surrogate endpoint as a primary outcome"],
    ["","6a.2","Justification for selected surrogate: a) evidence (or lack thereof) of surrogate endpoint validation; and b) evidence (or lack thereof) of validity being specific to setting and context used e.g., intervention; disease; population."],
    ["","6b","Any changes to trial outcomes after the trial commenced, with reasons"],
    ["Sample size","7a","How sample size was determined"],
    ["","7a.1","Clarify if sample size was estimated to demonstrate that a minimum effect on the surrogate endpoint would be predictive of a benefit on the target outcome(s)."],
    ["","7b","When applicable, explanation of any interim analyses and stopping guidelines"],
    ["#","Randomisation:"],
    ["Sequence generation","8a","Method used to generate the random allocation sequence"],
    ["","8b","Type of randomisation; details of any restriction (such as blocking and block size)"],
    ["Allocation concealment mechanism","9","Mechanism used to implement the random allocation sequence (such as sequentially numbered containers), describing any steps taken to conceal the sequence until interventions were assigned"],
    ["Implementation","10","Who generated the random allocation sequence, who enrolled participants, and who assigned participants to interventions"],
    ["Blinding","11a","If done, who was blinded after assignment to interventions (for example, participants, care providers, those assessing outcomes), and how"],
    ["","11b","If relevant, a description of the similarity of interventions"],
    ["Statistical methods","12a","Statistical methods used to compare groups for primary and secondary outcomes"],
    ["","12b","Methods for additional analyses, such as subgroup analyses and adjusted analyses"],
    "Results",
    ["Participant flow (a diagram is strongly recommended)","13a","For each group, the numbers of participants who were randomly assigned received intended treatment and were analysed for the primary outcome"],
    ["","13b","For each group, losses, and exclusions after randomisation, together with reasons"],
    ["Recruitment","14a","Dates defining the periods of recruitment and follow-up"],
    ["","14b","Why the trial ended or was stopped"],
    ["Baseline data","15","A table showing baseline demographic and clinical characteristics for each group"],
    ["Numbers analysed","16","For each group, the number of participants (denominator) included in each analysis and whether the analysis was by original assigned groups"],
    ["Outcomes and estimation","17a","For each primary and secondary outcome, results for each group, and the estimated effect size and its precision (such as 95% confidence interval)"],
    ["","17a.1","If the primary outcome is a composite outcome that includes a surrogate endpoint; report the intervention effect on all components."],
    ["","17b","For binary outcomes, the presentation of both absolute and relative effect sizes is recommended"],
    ["Ancillary analyses","18","Results of any other analyses performed, including subgroup analyses and adjusted analyses, distinguishing pre-specified from exploratory"],
    ["Harms","19","All important harms or unintended effects in each group (for specific guidance, see CONSORT for harms)"],
    "Discussion",
    ["Limitations","20","Trial limitations, addressing sources of potential bias, imprecision, and, if relevant, the multiplicity of analyses"],
    ["Generalisability","21","Generalisability (external validity, applicability) of the trial findings"],
    ["Interpretation","22","Interpretation consistent with results, balancing benefits and harms, and considering other relevant evidence"],
    ["","22.1","Interpretation of findings of the trial in the context of using a surrogate primary endpoint, including its known validity for intervention effects on the target outcome and the potential benefit-risk assessments of the tested intervention for participants."],
    ["","22.2","Comment on whether the trial design (including sample size and follow-up period), given the use of a surrogate endpoint, adequately captures the potential harms of the intervention being tested."],
    ["","22.3","State what the plans are to conduct subsequent analyses/studies to verify current findings on the target outcome(s)."],
    "Other information",
    ["Registration","23","Registration number and name of trial registry"],
    ["Protocol","24","Where the full trial protocol can be accessed, if available"],
    ["Funding","25","Sources of funding and other support (such as a supply of drugs), the role of funders"],
    "New items",
    ["Participant engagement","26.1","State whether and how trial participants were engaged and informed before enrolment that the trial was designed to evaluate an intervention’s effect using a surrogate endpoint."],
    ["Data access","26.2","If surrogate endpoint and target outcome data were collected in the trial, state the open access arrangements for the data for future secondary research."]
  ];
  const TITLE = "The combined CONSORT-Surrogate extension checklist";
  const FOOT = "Please cite as: Manyara AM, Davies P, Stewart D, et al. Reporting of surrogate endpoints in randomised controlled trial reports (CONSORT-Surrogate): extension checklist with explanation and elaboration. BMJ 2024;386:e078524. [[doi:10.1136/bmj-2023-078524|https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj-2023-078524]]";

  const STORE = "consort-surrogate-checklist-v1";
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#tp-table tbody");
  tbody.innerHTML = ROWS.map(r => {
    if (typeof r === "string") return `<tr class="sec"><td colspan="4">${r}</td></tr>`;
    if (r[0] === "#") return `<tr class="sub"><td colspan="4">${r[1]}</td></tr>`;
    const [topic, item, text] = r;
    return `<tr><td class="topic">${topic}</td><td class="item">${item}</td><td class="txt">${text}</td>` +
      `<td class="pg"><input type="text" data-key="p${item}" placeholder="page no." aria-label="Reported on page, item ${item}"></td></tr>`;
  }).join("");

  const fields = () => [...document.querySelectorAll("#tp-wrap input")];
  const load = () => { try { const d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
    fields().forEach(i => { if (d[i.dataset.key]) i.value = d[i.dataset.key]; }); } catch (e) {} };
  const save = () => { try { const d = {}; fields().forEach(i => { if (i.value) d[i.dataset.key] = i.value; });
    localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch (e) {} };
  load();
  document.getElementById("tp-wrap").addEventListener("input", save);

  // Save as PDF via the browser print dialog (print CSS shows only the checklist)
  document.getElementById("tp-pdf").onclick = () => {
    const old = document.title;
    document.title = "CONSORT-Surrogate checklist";
    window.print();
    document.title = old;
  };

  document.getElementById("tp-reset").onclick = () => {
    if (confirm("Clear all page numbers and the manuscript title?")) {
      fields().forEach(i => i.value = ""); save();
    }
  };

  // ---- Word (.docx) export -------------------------------------------------
  // <BUILD>
  function buildDocx(D, ROWS, vals, logo, eqLogo, title, foot) {
    const F = "Arial", SZ = 17, W = [1500, 700, 6966, 1300], TOTAL = W.reduce((a, b) => a + b);
    const ln = { style: D.BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 8, color: "222222" };
    const borders = { top: ln, bottom: ln, left: ln, right: ln };
    const dotted = { style: D.BorderStyle.DOTTED, size: 4, color: "444444" };
    const run = (text, o = {}) => new D.TextRun({ text, font: F, size: o.size || SZ, bold: o.bold, italics: o.italics, color: o.color });
    // turn "text [[label|url]]" into runs with hyperlinks
    const runs = (text, o = {}) => {
      const out = [], re = /\[\[(.*?)\|(.*?)\]\]/g; let last = 0, m;
      while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
        if (m.index > last) out.push(run(text.slice(last, m.index), o));
        out.push(new D.ExternalHyperlink({ link: m[2], children: [new D.TextRun({ text: m[1], font: F, size: o.size || SZ, color: "0563C1", underline: {} })] }));
        last = re.lastIndex;
      }
      if (last < text.length) out.push(run(text.slice(last), o));
      return out;
    };
    const cell = (i, text, o = {}) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: o.span ? W.slice(i, i + o.span).reduce((a, b) => a + b) : W[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA },
      columnSpan: o.span, verticalAlign: o.top ? D.VerticalAlign.TOP : D.VerticalAlign.CENTER,
      shading: o.fill ? { type: D.ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: o.fill, color: "auto" } : undefined,
      margins: { top: 40, bottom: 40, left: 90, right: 90 },
      borders: o.dotted ? { ...borders, top: dotted, bottom: dotted } : borders,
      children: [new D.Paragraph({ keepNext: o.keepNext, alignment: o.center ? D.AlignmentType.CENTER : D.AlignmentType.LEFT, children: runs(text, o) })]
    });
    const hd = { fill: "3A3F9E", color: "FFFFFF", bold: true };
    const head = new D.TableRow({ tableHeader: true, cantSplit: true, children: [
      cell(0, "Section/Topic", hd), cell(1, "Item No", { ...hd, center: true }),
      cell(2, "CONSORT-Surrogate items", hd), cell(3, "Reported on page No", { ...hd, center: true })] });
    const body = ROWS.map(r => {
      if (typeof r === "string") return new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r, { span: 4, fill: "DDE1F5", bold: true, keepNext: true })] });
      if (r[0] === "#") return new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [cell(0, r[1], { span: 4, fill: "EEF0FA", bold: true, italics: true, keepNext: true })] });
      return new D.TableRow({ cantSplit: true, children: [
        cell(0, r[0], { top: true }),
        cell(1, r[1], { center: true }),
        cell(2, r[2], { dotted: true }),
        cell(3, vals["p" + r[1]] || "", { center: true })] });
    });
    const para = (children, o = {}) => new D.Paragraph({ spacing: { after: 60 }, ...o, children });
    // read a PNG's pixel size from its header so logos keep their true aspect ratio
    const img = (data, w) => {
      let h = Math.round(w / 3);
      try { const dv = new DataView(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength); h = Math.round(w * dv.getUint32(20) / dv.getUint32(16)); } catch (e) {}
      return new D.ImageRun({ data, type: "png", transformation: { width: w, height: h } });
    };
    const none = { style: D.BorderStyle.NONE, size: 0, color: "FFFFFF" };
    const noBorders = { top: none, bottom: none, left: none, right: none };
    const HW = [6200, TOTAL - 6200];
    const hcell = (i, children) => new D.TableCell({
      width: { size: HW[i], type: D.WidthType.DXA }, borders: noBorders,
      verticalAlign: D.VerticalAlign.BOTTOM, margins: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 }, children });
    const left = logo ? [para([img(logo, 260)])] : [para([])];
    const right = eqLogo ? [para([img(eqLogo, 140)], { alignment: D.AlignmentType.RIGHT })] : [para([])];
    const top = [
      new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: HW, borders: { ...noBorders, insideHorizontal: none, insideVertical: none },
        rows: [new D.TableRow({ children: [hcell(0, left), hcell(1, right)] })] }),
      para([], { spacing: { after: 60 } }),
      para([run(title, { size: 22, bold: true })], { spacing: { after: 80 } }),
      para([run("Manuscript title: ", { bold: true, size: 20 }), run(vals.title || "", { size: 20 })], { spacing: { after: 120 } })
    ];
    return new D.Document({
      title: "CONSORT-Surrogate checklist", creator: "CONSORT-Surrogate checklist",
      sections: [{
        properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 }, margin: { top: 720, bottom: 720, left: 720, right: 720 } } },
        children: [...top,
          new D.Table({ width: { size: TOTAL, type: D.WidthType.DXA }, columnWidths: W, rows: [head, ...body] }),
          para(runs(foot, { size: 16 }), { spacing: { before: 140 } })]
      }]
    });
  }
  // </BUILD>

  const loadDocx = () => window.docx ? Promise.resolve() : new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const el = document.createElement("script");
    el.src = new URL("docx.min.js", document.baseURI).href;
    el.onload = res; el.onerror = () => rej(new Error("Could not load docx.min.js"));
    document.head.appendChild(el);
  });

  document.getElementById("tp-doc").onclick = async () => {
    const btn = document.getElementById("tp-doc"), label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing…";
    try {
      await loadDocx();
      let logo = null;
      try { logo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/consort-surrogate-logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      let eqLogo = null;
      try { eqLogo = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch(new URL("/assets/logos/equator_logo.png", document.baseURI))).arrayBuffer()); } catch (e) {}
      const vals = {}; fields().forEach(i => vals[i.dataset.key] = i.value);
      const blob = await window.docx.Packer.toBlob(buildDocx(window.docx, ROWS, vals, logo, eqLogo, TITLE, FOOT));
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([blob], { type: "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" }));
      a.download = "CONSORT-Surrogate-checklist.docx";
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Sorry, the Word file could not be created. " + e.message);
    } finally { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label; }
  };
})();
</script>
```
